rationale: First-order-plus-delay heater: y_ss=y_amb+K*u with y_amb~0.15 from E2 settled 0.155 and K~1.0 from E4 settled 0.409 at u=0.25 (0.254/0.25=1.02). E1 0.5->0.52 after 200s still rising and E5 0.25->0.4 rising 0.41->0.53 in 170s extrapolate to 0.58-0.73, consistent with K~1.0-1.1, tau~150-200s, delay 10-25s. So hold for 0.5 is (0.5-0.15)/1.03~0.34. Use feedforward 0.34 plus PI for residual. Kp=0.65 gives P~0.23 for full 0.35 error -> u~0.57, heating ~0.0034/s, no saturation. Ki=0.008 (Ti~81s) trims offset without aggressive windup. Integrate only when |e|<0.15 so initial 0.35 error does not wind up integrator (would add ~0.13 overshoot otherwise). Integral +-0.25 leaves >2x authority over max FF error ~0.11. Filter Tf=15s vs tau 170s smooths 0.02-0.04 noise with negligible lag. U_MAX=0.65 plus yf>0.75/0.80 backstop guarantees steady y<0.82 nominal and forced cooling before 0.85/0.9 even if K=1.2. Rate limit 0.08/s smooths noise chatter.
